anim-studio.animated-svg.contains-a-link.note: Error in the animated SVG tool when an imported SVG holds a link (an anchor element), which the studio rejects for safety.

anim-studio.animated-svg.contains-an-ele.text: Contains an element that runs or fetches.
anim-studio.animated-svg.contains-an-ele.note: Error in the animated SVG tool when an imported SVG holds a script or an element that loads outside content, which is refused for safety.

anim-studio.animated-svg.contains-an-eve.note: Error in the animated SVG tool when an imported SVG has an event attribute such as onclick, which is refused for safety.

anim-studio.animated-svg.contains-an-ext.note: Error in the animated SVG tool when an imported SVG points to a file or address outside itself, which is refused for safety.

anim-studio.animated-svg.nothing-is-draw.note: Error in the animated SVG tool when the pasted markup has no visible shapes.

anim-studio.animated-svg.only-keyframe-a.text: Only keyframe animations export as an animated SVG.
anim-studio.animated-svg.only-keyframe-a.note: Notice in the SVG export tool when the open animation is not a keyframe animation (for example particles), so it cannot be exported as an animated SVG.

anim-studio.animated-svg.states-clips-ar.text: States (clips) are not exported: the file plays the animation’s own timeline.
anim-studio.animated-svg.states-clips-ar.note: Warning in the SVG export tool when the animation has states (clips) that play per entity state; the exported file only plays the main timeline.

anim-studio.animated-svg.the-animation-i.note: Error shown when SVG export fails. {message} is the validation error from the animation check, already worded for the user.

vars.message: The value that replaces message in the text.

anim-studio.animated-svg.the-colour-is-n.text: The colour is not a valid CSS colour: the file uses currentColor.
anim-studio.animated-svg.the-colour-is-n.note: Warning in the SVG export tool when a colour in the animation cannot be written as a CSS colour, so the file falls back to currentColor (the text colour of the page).

anim-studio.animated-svg.the-file-is-siz.text: The file is {size} KB, larger than 256 KB.
anim-studio.animated-svg.the-file-is-siz.note: Warning about an imported SVG file that is too big. {size} is the file size as a number in kilobytes; 256 KB is the fixed limit.

vars.size: The value that replaces size in the text.

anim-studio.animated-svg.the-file-loops-.text: The file loops: the repeat count is not exported.
anim-studio.animated-svg.the-file-loops-.note: Warning in the SVG export tool when the animation repeats a set number of times; the exported file loops forever instead.

anim-studio.animated-svg.the-icon-has-no.text: The icon has no shapes to export.
anim-studio.animated-svg.the-icon-has-no.note: Error in the SVG export tool when the icon has no drawable shapes, so there is nothing to write to the file.

anim-studio.animated-svg.the-smil-fallba.text: The SMIL fallback plays the animation forwards only.
anim-studio.animated-svg.the-smil-fallba.note: Warning in the SVG export tool: viewers that use the older SMIL animation fallback play the animation forwards only, without reverse or alternate direction.

anim-studio.animated-svg.tracks-of-card-.text: Tracks of card parts (name, state, background) are not exported.
anim-studio.animated-svg.tracks-of-card-.note: Warning in the SVG export tool: keyframe tracks that animate card parts other than the icon are left out of the exported file.

anim-studio.animated-svg.unexpected-elem.note: Error for an SVG file with a tag the studio does not accept. {element} is the tag name, such as script; keep the angle brackets.

vars.element: The value that replaces element in the text.

anim-studio.animated-svg.unknown-error.note: Lower-case fallback reason inserted into an error message when the SVG tool gives no detail.

anim-studio.animated-svg.value-bindings-.text: Value bindings are not exported: the file plays at the drawn values.
anim-studio.animated-svg.value-bindings-.note: Warning in the SVG export tool: entity value bindings are dropped, so the exported file always plays with the values as drawn.

anim-studio.bezier-editor.default.note: Option in the easing preset list that uses the easing the animation already inherits.

anim-studio.bezier-editor.default-inheri.note: Placeholder in the easing text field, shown while it is empty. {inherited} is the easing that applies by default, as a preset name or a cubic-bezier value; keep it as is.

vars.inherited: The value that replaces inherited in the text.

anim-studio.bezier-editor.easing.note: Label of the easing field. Easing is the speed curve of a motion between two keyframes.

anim-studio.bezier-editor.easing-value.note: Accessible name of the text field where the easing is typed as a preset or curve.

anim-studio.bezier-editor.end-handle.note: Accessible name of the draggable control point that shapes the end of the easing curve.

anim-studio.bezier-editor.in-out.note: Group heading for easing presets that start and end slowly, in a preset list.

anim-studio.bezier-editor.label-preset.note: Accessible name of the group of easing preset buttons. {label} is the name of the field it belongs to, or 'Easing' when it has none.

vars.label: The value that replaces label in the text.

anim-studio.bezier-editor.start-handle.note: Accessible name of the draggable control point that shapes the start of the easing curve.

anim-studio.bezier-editor.steps-jump-bet.text: Steps jump between values; there is no curve to edit.
anim-studio.bezier-editor.steps-jump-bet.note: Hint in the easing editor, shown instead of the curve graph when the easing is steps(n), which has no bezier curve to drag.

anim-studio.bezier-editor.the-animation-.note: Tooltip of the 'Default' easing preset button, meaning no easing of its own. {easingLabel} is the lowercase name of the easing it falls back to.

vars.easingLabel: The value that replaces easingLabel in the text.

anim-studio.bezier-editor.use-a-preset-n.text: Use a preset name, cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2) or steps(n).
anim-studio.bezier-editor.use-a-preset-n.note: Error under the easing text field when the typed value is not a known easing. Keep the cubic-bezier and steps syntax as is.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.add-value-bin.note: Button in the bindings panel that links an animation property to an entity value.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.at-most-max-b.text: {max, plural, one {At most # binding per animation.} other {At most # bindings per animation.}}
anim-studio.bindings-panel.at-most-max-b.note: Hint shown when the binding limit is reached. {max} is the maximum number of entity bindings, a whole number.

vars.max: The most bindings an animation holds.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.attribute.note: Label of the field naming the entity attribute whose value drives the binding.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.attribute-nam.text: Attribute names use letters, digits, _ . and - (no spaces).
anim-studio.bindings-panel.attribute-nam.note: Error under the attribute field of a binding when the typed attribute name has characters Home Assistant attribute names do not use.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.background.note: Option in the binding target list: the card background, as opposed to an element or icon.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.binding-added.note: Screen-reader announcement after adding a binding (not shown on screen). {property} is the name of the animated property it drives, such as Rotation.

vars.property: The value that replaces property in the text.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.binding-delet.note: Confirmation announced after the user removes a binding from the bindings panel.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.binding-n.note: Heading of one binding card in the list. {n} is its position in the list, counting from 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.delete-bindin.note: Button label and tooltip that removes the selected binding from the bindings panel.
Accessible name (screen readers only) of the delete icon button on a binding; the tooltip is the separate 'Delete binding'. {n} is the binding's position in the list, from 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.drive-name-fr.text: Drive {name} from the entity’s value: rotation speed from a fan’s percentage, a fill from a battery level.
anim-studio.bindings-panel.drive-name-fr.note: Help text under the bindings list. {name} is the lowercase name of the animation property being driven, such as 'rotation'.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.element.note: Option in the binding target list: a single element of the card, such as a shape or text.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.empty-reads-t.text: Empty reads the state. For example percentage (fan) or brightness (light).
anim-studio.bindings-panel.empty-reads-t.note: Help text under the attribute field of a binding: leaving it empty reads the entity state; examples are real attribute names. Keep the attribute names as is.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.entity-value.note: Label for the input source of a binding: the number read from the entity or its attribute.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.from-colour.note: Label of the colour used when the value is at its minimum, in a colour-mix binding.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.from-unit.note: Field label for the lower end of a value range. {unit} is the unit, already with its own leading space (such as ' (%)') or empty; do not add a space.

vars.unit: The value that replaces unit in the text.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.icon.note: Option in the binding target list: the icon of the card.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.max.note: Label of the number field for the highest input value of a binding. Keep it short.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.min.note: Label of the number field for the lowest input value of a binding. Keep it short.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.name.note: Option in the binding target list: the card name text, or the label of the name field.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.output.note: Label of the output range fields: what the target property becomes at min and max.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.property.note: Label of the list that picks which property of the target the binding changes, such as opacity.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.smoothing-s.note: Label of the field for how many seconds a value change is eased over; (s) means seconds.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.state.note: Label of the binding source that reads the entity state itself, capitalised as a field label.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.state-2.note: Lower-case word for the entity state, slotted into a longer sentence. Keep it lower case.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.the-backgroun.note: Noun phrase for the card background, slotted into a sentence about a binding target.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.the-element.note: Noun phrase for the chosen element, slotted into a sentence about a binding target.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.the-entity-s-.text: The entity’s value drives {name}. Preview it with the value slider on the stage.
anim-studio.bindings-panel.the-entity-s-.note: Status text shown while a binding is active. {name} is the lowercase name of the driven property, such as 'rotation'.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.the-icon.note: Noun phrase for the card icon, slotted into a sentence about a binding target.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.the-name.note: Noun phrase for the card name text, slotted into a sentence about a binding target.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.the-state.note: Noun phrase for the entity state, slotted into a sentence about a binding source.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.to-colour.note: Label of the colour used when the value is at its maximum, in a colour-mix binding.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.to-unit.note: Field label for the upper end of a value range. {unit} is the unit, already with its own leading space (such as ' (%)') or empty; do not add a space.

vars.unit: The value that replaces unit in the text.

anim-studio.bindings-panel.value-binding.note: Heading of the panel listing bindings that link an entity value to a visual property.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.attribute-nam.text: Attribute names use letters, digits, _ . and -.
anim-studio.bindings-utils.attribute-nam.note: Validation error for a binding whose attribute name has characters other than letters, digits, underscore, dot or hyphen.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.blends-from-t.text: Blends from the first colour to the second.
anim-studio.bindings-utils.blends-from-t.note: Description of the Colour mix binding property, shown in the property list: the colour moves from the first to the second as the value rises.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.colour-mix.note: Name of a binding property that blends between two colours as the value changes.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.draw.note: Name of a binding property that draws a line on progressively, like a gauge filling.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.draws-the-lin.text: Draws the line on (a battery or level).
anim-studio.bindings-utils.draws-the-lin.note: Description of the Draw binding property, shown in the property list: the outline draws in as the value rises, like a battery or level indicator.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.fades-in-with.note: Description of the Opacity binding property, shown in the property list: the target becomes more visible as the value rises.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.grows-with-th.note: Description of the Scale binding property, shown in the property list: the target becomes larger as the value rises.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.min-and-max-m.note: Validation error on a binding whose Min and Max input values are equal, which leaves no range to map.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.move-x.note: Name of a binding property that moves the target horizontally. X is the horizontal axis.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.move-y.note: Name of a binding property that moves the target vertically. Y is the vertical axis.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.moves-sideway.note: Short description of a binding that changes the horizontal position of the target.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.moves-up-or-d.note: Description of the Move Y binding property, shown in the property list: the target shifts vertically with the value.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.opacity.note: Name of a binding property that fades the target, from transparent to fully visible.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.playback-spee.note: Name of a binding property that changes how fast this animation plays.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.plays-this-an.text: Plays this animation faster or slower.
anim-studio.bindings-utils.plays-this-an.note: Description of the Playback speed binding property, shown in the property list: the animation speeds up or slows down with the value.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.rotation.note: Name of a binding property that turns the target to an angle, such as a dial needle.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.rotation-spee.note: Name of a binding property that spins the target continuously, faster as the value rises.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.scale.note: Name of a binding property that makes the target larger or smaller as the value changes.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.spins-continu.text: Spins continuously, faster as the value rises (a fan).
anim-studio.bindings-utils.spins-continu.note: Description of the Rotation speed binding property, shown in the property list: the target keeps turning and speeds up with the value.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.the-timeline-.text: The timeline also animates the draw here: while it plays, it wins over this binding.
anim-studio.bindings-utils.the-timeline-.note: Warning under a Draw binding when the keyframe timeline animates the same draw-on property; the timeline takes priority while it plays.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.the-timeline-.text: The timeline also animates the opacity here: while it plays, its opacity wins over this binding.
anim-studio.bindings-utils.the-timeline-.note: Warning under an Opacity binding when the keyframe timeline animates the same opacity; the timeline takes priority while it plays.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.the-timeline-.text: The timeline also animates this colour: while it plays, its colour wins over this binding.
anim-studio.bindings-utils.the-timeline-.note: Warning under a Colour mix binding when the keyframe timeline animates the same colour; the timeline takes priority while it plays.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.the-timeline-.text: The timeline skews this target: while it plays, the skew replaces this binding’s movement.
anim-studio.bindings-utils.the-timeline-.note: Warning under a Move binding when the keyframe timeline skews the same target; the skew replaces the binding's movement while it plays.

anim-studio.bindings-utils.turns-to-an-a.text: Turns to an angle (a needle or a dial).
anim-studio.bindings-utils.turns-to-an-a.note: Description of the Rotation binding property, shown in the property list: the target turns to an angle set by the value.

anim-studio.canvas-host.add-point.note: Undo-history label for inserting a new point on a path in the drawing canvas.

anim-studio.canvas-host.change-point-typ.note: Undo-history label for switching a path point between a corner and a smooth curve.

anim-studio.canvas-host.close-path.note: Undo-history label for joining the last point of an open path back to its first point.

anim-studio.canvas-host.couldn-t-load-th.note: Error shown in the studio canvas when the drawing tools failed to load; a Try again button sits beside it.

anim-studio.canvas-host.delete-handle.note: Undo-history label for removing one curve handle from a path point.

anim-studio.canvas-host.delete-point.note: Undo-history label for removing a single point from a path. Singular form.

anim-studio.canvas-host.delete-points.note: Undo-history label for removing several selected points from a path. Plural form.

anim-studio.canvas-host.move-handle.note: Undo-history label for dragging a curve handle of a path point.

anim-studio.canvas-host.move-path.note: Undo-history label for dragging a whole path to a new position.

anim-studio.canvas-host.move-point.note: Undo-history label for dragging a single path point. Singular form.

anim-studio.canvas-host.move-points.note: Undo-history label for dragging several selected path points together. Plural form.

anim-studio.canvas-host.reload-page.note: Button that reloads the browser page so the matching version of the drawing tools loads.

anim-studio.canvas-host.reloading-the-pa.text: Reloading the page discards changes that are not saved. Reload anyway?
anim-studio.canvas-host.reloading-the-pa.note: Confirmation question in a dialog before the Reload page button reloads the browser page and loses unsaved studio edits.

anim-studio.canvas-host.the-drawing-tool.text: The drawing tools on this page are from another Magic Card version. Reload the page to draw here.
anim-studio.canvas-host.the-drawing-tool.note: Error shown in the studio canvas when the loaded drawing tools do not match the card version; a Reload page button sits beside it.

anim-studio.canvas-host.try-again.note: Button shown beside the drawing-tools load error that retries loading them.

anim-studio.draw-host.arrow-keys-move-th.text: Arrow keys move the cursor, Enter places points, Escape cancels.
anim-studio.draw-host.arrow-keys-move-th.note: Keyboard help appended to the drawing canvas's accessible name, read by screen readers. Keep the key names as is.

anim-studio.draw-host.at-most-count-shap.text: {count, plural, one {At most # shape fits in a rig.} other {At most # shapes fit in a rig.}}
anim-studio.draw-host.at-most-count-shap.note: Message when the drawing limit is reached. {count} is the maximum number of shapes, a whole number.

vars.count: The most shapes a rig holds.

anim-studio.draw-host.at-most-tracks-ani.text: {tracks, plural, one {At most # animated target.} other {At most # animated targets.}}
anim-studio.draw-host.at-most-tracks-ani.note: Message when too many parts are animated. {tracks} is the maximum number of animated targets, a whole number.

vars.tracks: The most animated targets an animation holds.

anim-studio.draw-host.click-to-add-the-n.text: Click to add the next point
anim-studio.draw-host.click-to-add-the-n.note: Status hint while drawing a freeform shape on the stage; the path editor has its own copy.

anim-studio.draw-host.cursor-at-x-x-y-y-.text: Cursor at x {x}, y {y}. Press Enter to add a point.
anim-studio.draw-host.cursor-at-x-x-y-y-.note: Screen-reader announcement while drawing with the keyboard. {x} and {y} are the cursor's coordinates on the canvas, whole numbers.

vars.x: The value that replaces x in the text.
vars.y: The value that replaces y in the text.

anim-studio.draw-host.cursor-at-x-x-y-y-.text: Cursor at x {x}, y {y}. Press Enter to finish.
anim-studio.draw-host.cursor-at-x-x-y-y-.note: Screen-reader announcement while drawing with the keyboard and a shape is under way. {x} and {y} are the cursor's coordinates on the canvas.

vars.x: The value that replaces x in the text.
vars.y: The value that replaces y in the text.

anim-studio.draw-host.cursor-at-x-x-y-y-.text: Cursor at x {x}, y {y}. Press Enter to start.
anim-studio.draw-host.cursor-at-x-x-y-y-.note: Screen-reader announcement while drawing with the keyboard before a shape has begun. {x} and {y} are the cursor's coordinates on the canvas.

vars.x: The value that replaces x in the text.
vars.y: The value that replaces y in the text.

anim-studio.draw-host.drawing.note: Accessible name or heading of the drawing region, used as a noun.

anim-studio.draw-host.drawing-area.note: Lower-case role description read by screen readers for the canvas where shapes are drawn.

anim-studio.draw-host.drawing-cancelled.note: Message shown when the user abandons a shape they were drawing on the stage.

anim-studio.draw-host.drop-the-svg-to-im.note: Overlay on the drawing stage while a file is dragged over it; dropping an .svg file imports it as shapes.

anim-studio.draw-host.erase-shapes.note: Undo-history label for one eraser stroke. {count} is how many shapes the stroke erased; the label is singular for one shape.

vars.count: The count the text is about.

anim-studio.draw-host.finish-path.note: Button shown while drawing a path with the pen or freehand tool; it ends the path.

anim-studio.draw-host.label-tool-hint.note: Accessible name of the drawing canvas. {label} is the name of the selected tool, such as Pen; {hint} is a short sentence on how to use it, followed by keyboard help.

vars.hint: The value that replaces hint in the text.
vars.label: The value that replaces label in the text.

anim-studio.draw-host.move-away-from-the.text: Move away from the start first.
anim-studio.draw-host.move-away-from-the.note: Message when the user tries to close a freehand or pen path on its first point before moving away from it.

anim-studio.draw-host.name-added.note: Screen-reader announcement after a shape is drawn. {name} is the shape's default name, such as Rectangle 2.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.draw-host.name-added-count-p.text: {count, plural, one {{name} added, # point.} other {{name} added, # points.}}
anim-studio.draw-host.name-added-count-p.note: Screen-reader announcement after a pen path is finished. {name} is the new shape's name; {count} is its number of anchor points, a whole number.

vars.count: The number of points in the shape.
vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.draw-host.name-is-locked-unl.text: {name} is locked. Unlock it in Layers.
anim-studio.draw-host.name-is-locked-unl.note: Screen-reader announcement when an edit is refused. {name} is the shape's name, or the word 'shape'; Layers is the panel's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.draw-host.no-shapes-yet-pick.text: No shapes yet: pick a drawing tool.
anim-studio.draw-host.no-shapes-yet-pick.note: Empty-state hint on the drawing stage when the rig has no shapes; it tells the user to choose a tool from the toolbar.

anim-studio.draw-host.path.note: Default name of a shape drawn with the pen tool; a number is appended, as in 'Path 2'.

anim-studio.draw-host.pen-click-to-add-p.text: Pen. Click to add points, click the first point to close.
anim-studio.draw-host.pen-click-to-add-p.note: Usage hint for the pen tool, shown as the tool's status text and used in the canvas's accessible name.

anim-studio.draw-host.point-count-placed.text: Point {count} placed. Enter again on the same spot finishes the stroke.
anim-studio.draw-host.point-count-placed.note: Screen-reader announcement after the Enter key places a point. {count} is the number of points placed so far, counting from 1.

vars.count: The value that replaces count in the text.

anim-studio.draw-host.select-a-part-or-s.text: Select a part or shape first.
anim-studio.draw-host.select-a-part-or-s.note: Hint shown when the user picks a drawing tool on the stage without a selection.

anim-studio.draw-host.select-a-part-or-s.text: Select a part or shape, then draw its motion path.
anim-studio.draw-host.select-a-part-or-s.note: Status hint on the drawing stage for the motion path tool; it tells the user to select a part first.

anim-studio.draw-host.shape.note: Fallback name for a shape, used in messages such as the locked-layer announcement when the shape has no name.

anim-studio.draw-host.shape-points-drag-.text: Shape points. Drag a point to move it.
anim-studio.draw-host.shape-points-drag-.note: Accessible name of the point-editing layer on the drawing stage, read by screen readers, with a short usage hint.

anim-studio.draw-host.started-at-x-x-y-y.text: Started at x {x}, y {y}. Move the cursor and press Enter to finish. Escape cancels.
anim-studio.draw-host.started-at-x-x-y-y.note: Screen-reader announcement when a keyboard-drawn shape begins. {x} and {y} are the start point's coordinates on the canvas. Enter and Escape are key names.

vars.x: The value that replaces x in the text.
vars.y: The value that replaces y in the text.

anim-studio.draw-host.stroke.note: Default name of a shape drawn with the freehand tool; a number is appended, as in 'Stroke 2'.

anim-studio.draw-host.that-layer-is-lock.text: That layer is locked. Unlock it in Layers.
anim-studio.draw-host.that-layer-is-lock.note: Message on the drawing stage when the user edits a locked layer; Layers is the name of the layers panel.

anim-studio.draw-host.the-drawing-tools-.text: The drawing tools are not loaded yet.
anim-studio.draw-host.the-drawing-tools-.note: Message on the drawing stage when the user starts to draw before the lazy-loaded drawing tools have finished loading.

anim-studio.draw-host.the-path-has-the-m.text: The path has the most points it can hold.
anim-studio.draw-host.the-path-has-the-m.note: Message on the drawing stage when the user tries to add a point to a path that reached the point limit.

anim-studio.draw-layers.bring-name-forwa.note: Accessible name of the move-up button on a shape row, one step in the stacking order. {name} is the shape's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.draw-layers.bring-name-over-.note: Accessible name of the move-up button when the shape is at the top of the layer below the icon, so the next step puts it over the icon. {name} is the shape's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.draw-layers.bring-over-the-i.note: Menu item that moves the selected shape in front of the card icon. Compare 'Send under the icon'.

anim-studio.key-inspector.flip-sideways-.note: Choice for the 3D turn axis: swing like a door, around the Y axis. Keep the letter Y.

anim-studio.key-inspector.keyframe-inspe.note: Accessible name of the whole side panel that edits the selected keyframes. Read by screen readers only.

vars.max: The value that replaces max in the text.

vars.unit: The value that replaces unit in the text.

anim-studio.key-inspector.names-share-th.note: Help text after the easing field. {names} is a list of the property names that use the same curve, joined by commas, such as Scale X, Scale Y.

vars.names: The value that replaces names in the text.

anim-studio.key-inspector.not-a-valid-co.note: Error under a colour field in the keyframe inspector when the typed value cannot be parsed.

anim-studio.key-inspector.not-an-allowed.text: Not an allowed shadow: x y blur spread colour.
anim-studio.key-inspector.not-an-allowed.note: Error under the shadow field in the key inspector when the typed value does not follow the allowed order of offsets, blur, spread and colour.

anim-studio.key-inspector.only-this-prop.text: Only this property. Default follows the keyframe's easing.

anim-studio.key-inspector.only-this-prop.text: Only this property. Default follows the keyframe's easing (the animation easing).

anim-studio.key-inspector.opacity.note: Property label in the keyframe inspector for how see-through the part is, as a percentage (100% is solid).

anim-studio.key-inspector.position.note: Property label in the keyframe inspector for where the part sits (moves along X and Y).

anim-studio.key-inspector.property-keys-.text: Property keys get their own easing; whole keyframes set the keyframe's easing.

anim-studio.key-inspector.radius.note: Property label in the keyframe inspector for the corner rounding of a shape or part.

anim-studio.key-inspector.remove-from-th.note: Tooltip and accessible name of the button in the key inspector that removes one property from the selected keyframe.

anim-studio.key-inspector.remove-name-fr.note: Accessible name of a remove icon button next to one property. {name} is the lowercase property name, such as rotation.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.key-inspector.scale.note: Property label in the keyframe inspector for resizing the part evenly in both directions (one number).

anim-studio.key-inspector.scale-x.note: Property label in the keyframe inspector for stretching the part sideways only (width). Keep the letter X.

anim-studio.key-inspector.scale-y.note: Property label in the keyframe inspector for stretching the part up and down only (height). Keep the letter Y.

anim-studio.key-inspector.shadow.note: Property label in the keyframe inspector for a drop shadow behind the part (offset, blur, spread and colour).

anim-studio.key-inspector.shadow-colour.note: Label of the colour picker for the shadow property in the keyframe inspector.

anim-studio.key-inspector.shadow-name.note: Label of a shadow sub-field. {name} is the lowercase name of the shadow part, such as blur or colour.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.key-inspector.shadow-presets.note: Accessible label of the group of ready-made shadow buttons in the keyframe inspector.

anim-studio.key-inspector.skew-x.note: Property label in the keyframe inspector for slanting the part sideways, in degrees. Keep the letter X.

anim-studio.key-inspector.skew-y.note: Property label in the keyframe inspector for slanting the part up or down, in degrees. Keep the letter Y.

anim-studio.key-inspector.spread.note: Label of the shadow sub-field for how far the shadow grows beyond the part, in pixels.

anim-studio.key-inspector.stroke-colour.note: Property label in the keyframe inspector for the outline colour of a shape or part.

anim-studio.key-inspector.target-at-at-s.note: Subtitle for a keyframe when several parts are selected. {target} is the name of the part; {at} is its timeline position as a percentage; {secs} is the same moment in seconds.

vars.at: The value that replaces at in the text.
vars.secs: The value that replaces secs in the text.
vars.target: The value that replaces target in the text.

anim-studio.key-inspector.text-and-icon-.note: Label of the colour property in the key inspector that tints the card's text and icon.

anim-studio.key-inspector.the-entity-col.text: The entity colour button uses the animation colour (the card entry's colour, else the entity's).
anim-studio.key-inspector.the-entity-col.note: Tooltip of the entity colour button next to a colour field in the key inspector, explaining which colour it fills in.

anim-studio.key-inspector.the-selected-k.text: The selected keyframes use different easings; a choice here sets all of them.
anim-studio.key-inspector.the-selected-k.note: Hint in the key inspector's easing field when several selected keyframes disagree; picking an easing overwrites all of them.

anim-studio.key-inspector.this-is-the-la.text: This is the lane's last key: no segment follows it, so its easing has no effect.
anim-studio.key-inspector.this-is-the-la.note: Notice in the key inspector's easing field when the selected key is the last on its timeline lane.

anim-studio.key-inspector.this-is-the-la.text: This is the last keyframe: no segment follows it, so its easing has no effect.
anim-studio.key-inspector.this-is-the-la.note: Notice in the key inspector's easing field when the selected keyframe is the last one of the animation.

anim-studio.key-inspector.this-keyframe-.text: This keyframe sets no property. Add one with Add property.
anim-studio.key-inspector.this-keyframe-.note: Empty state in the key inspector for a keyframe without properties. Add property is the name of a button.

anim-studio.key-inspector.turn.note: Property label in the keyframe inspector for a 3D turn of the part around a chosen axis. Noun, not a verb.

anim-studio.key-inspector.use-a-colour-o.text: Use a colour or a gradient.
anim-studio.key-inspector.use-a-colour-o.note: Error under a colour field in the key inspector when the typed value is neither a colour nor a gradient.

anim-studio.key-inspector.use-filter-fun.text: Use filter functions like brightness(1.2) hue-rotate(30deg); url() is not allowed.
anim-studio.key-inspector.use-filter-fun.note: Error under the filter field in the key inspector when the typed value is not an allowed CSS filter. Keep the CSS examples as is.

anim-studio.key-inspector.where-from-to-.note: Subtitle for several selected keyframes. {where} is the part name or '2 targets'; {from} and {to} are the earliest and latest timeline positions as percentages.

vars.from: The value that replaces from in the text.
vars.to: The value that replaces to in the text.
vars.where: The value that replaces where in the text.

anim-studio.key-inspector.whole-keyframe.note: Easing choice that applies one curve to every property of the keyframe, instead of a single property.

anim-studio.key-inspector.x.note: Single-letter label of the sideways (horizontal) value in a pair of position fields. Keep the letter X.

anim-studio.key-inspector.y.note: Single-letter label of the up-and-down (vertical) value in a pair of position fields. Keep the letter Y.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.add-a-keyfr.text: Add a keyframe at the playhead
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.add-a-keyfr.note: Tooltip and accessible name of the timeline button that adds a keyframe at the current playhead position.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.add-a-name-.text: Add a {name} keyframe at the playhead
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.add-a-name-.note: Accessible name of the add button on a parent track row (not a single property row). {name} is the lowercase track name, such as shadow.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.add-a-prope.note: Tooltip of the add-property button on the timeline. {target} is the name of the selected animated part.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.add-keyfram.note: Timeline toolbar button that adds a keyframe to the selected part at the playhead position.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.add-lane-ke.note: Name of an undo step, not shown on a control. {lane} is the lowercase name of the property the keyframe animates, such as rotation.

vars.lane: The value that replaces lane in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.add-name-ke.note: Accessible name of the add button on a single property row. {name} is the lowercase property name, such as rotation. The English without 'a' differs from the parent-row text on purpose.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.add-propert.note: Button on the timeline that lists properties (rotation, opacity and so on) to add as a new lane for the selected part.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.add-propert.text: Add property to {target} at the playhead ({at})
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.add-propert.note: Accessible name of the add-property control. {target} is the name of the selected animated part; {at} is the playhead position as a percentage, such as 40%.

vars.at: The value that replaces at in the text.
vars.target: The value that replaces target in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.arrows-move.text: Arrows move the keyframe, Alt and arrows go to the next one, Delete removes it.
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.arrows-move.note: Keyboard help in the accessible name of a keyframe marker on the timeline. Keep the key names as is.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.at-the-play.note: Tooltip of the current-value chip for a filter property. {filter} is the CSS filter value, such as blur(2px); do not translate it.

vars.filter: The value that replaces filter in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.at-the-play.note: Tooltip of the current-value chip for a property. {text} is the property's value at the playhead, such as 45deg or a colour; do not translate it.

vars.text: The value that replaces text in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.collapse.note: Tooltip of the fold button on a timeline track row that hides its property lanes. Verb; the named version has its own key.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.collapse-na.note: Button label in the keyframes editor that folds a layer's lanes. {name} is the layer or target name; do not translate it.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.copy-ctrl-c.note: Tooltip of the copy button on the timeline toolbar, with its keyboard shortcut. Keep Ctrl+C as written.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.copy-keyfra.note: Accessible name of the copy button on the timeline toolbar when keyframes are selected and can be copied.
Tooltip of the paste button while it is disabled, because nothing has been copied yet. Tells the user the next step.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.count-copie.text: {count, plural, one {# keyframe} other {# keyframes}} copied
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.count-copie.note: Confirmation in the keyframes editor after copying. {count} is the number of keyframes copied.

vars.count: The count the text is about.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.count-delet.text: {count, plural, one {# keyframe} other {# keyframes}} deleted
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.count-delet.note: Confirmation in the keyframes editor after deleting. {count} is the number of keyframes deleted.

vars.count: The count the text is about.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.count-paste.text: {count, plural, one {# keyframe} other {# keyframes}} pasted at {at}{skipped}
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.count-paste.note: Screen-reader announcement after pasting keyframes. {count} is the number pasted, {at} is the playhead position as a percentage, and {skipped} is empty or the separate 'skipped' sentence that starts with a semicolon.

vars.at: The value that replaces at in the text.
vars.count: The count the text is about.
vars.skipped: The value that replaces skipped in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.ctrl-wheel-.note: Hint under the keyframes timeline explaining how to zoom with the mouse wheel.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.cycle.note: Label of the timeline control for the length of one animation loop, in seconds. Noun, not a verb.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.delete-del.note: Tooltip of the delete button on the timeline toolbar, with its keyboard shortcut. Keep Del as written.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.delete-keyf.note: Accessible name of the delete button on the timeline toolbar. Also the name of the undo step after deleting.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.drag-to-mov.text: Drag to move (snaps; Shift: free, Alt: duplicate). Ctrl-click adds a key, Shift-click selects a range. Arrows move, Alt and arrows go to the next key, Delete removes.
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.drag-to-mov.note: Tooltip of a keyframe marker on the timeline listing mouse and keyboard actions. Keep the key names as is.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.duplicate-c.note: Label of the undo step and drag status when Alt-dragging copies keyframes. {count} is how many keyframes are copied.

vars.count: The count the text is about.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.empty-keyfr.note: Name of a keyframe marker on the timeline that does not set any property yet.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.expand.note: Tooltip of the fold button on a timeline track row that shows its property lanes. Verb; the named version has its own key.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.expand-name.note: Button label in the keyframes editor that unfolds a layer's lanes. {name} is the layer or target name; do not translate it.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.fit-the-cyc.note: Short label of the zoom button that scales the timeline so one full loop fills the width. Shown on the button itself.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.fit-the-who.note: Longer tooltip of the same zoom-to-fit button as Fit the cycle; explains it shows one full loop.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.keyframe.note: Lowercase noun used inside a longer label, such as a marker name. Not a heading; the capitalised word has other keys.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.keyframe-ti.note: Accessible name of the timeline region that holds the lanes and keyframe markers. Read by screen readers only.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.keyframe-to.note: Accessible name of the timeline toolbar with the add, copy, paste and delete buttons.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.keyframes.note: Heading of the timeline panel. Plural noun; each keyframe is a saved value at one moment of the loop.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.label-at-at.note: Tooltip of a keyframe marker with no value. {label} is a capitalised phrase such as 'Rotation keyframe' and {at} is its position as a percentage.

vars.at: The value that replaces at in the text.
vars.label: The value that replaces label in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.label-at-at.note: Tooltip of a keyframe marker that has a value. {label} is a capitalised phrase such as 'Rotation keyframe', {at} is its position as a percentage and {value} is the keyframe's value.

vars.at: The value that replaces at in the text.
vars.label: The value that replaces label in the text.
vars.value: The value that replaces value in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.label-lane.note: Accessible name of one property lane in the keyframes editor. {label} is the translated property name, such as Rotation; 'lane' is a row on the timeline.

vars.label: The value that replaces label in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.lane-keyfra.note: Name of a keyframe marker on a single-target timeline. {lane} is the lowercase property name, such as rotation; the result is capitalised afterwards.

vars.lane: The value that replaces lane in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.locked.note: Lowercase word appended to a layer name in a timeline label to say the layer is locked and cannot be edited.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.move-count.note: Label of the undo step and drag status when dragging keyframes along the timeline. {count} is how many keyframes move.

vars.count: The count the text is about.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.move-keyfra.note: Accessible name of a keyframe marker that can be dragged or moved with the arrow keys along the timeline.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.name-is-loc.text: {name} is locked. Unlock it in Layers.
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.name-is-loc.note: Message when an edit is refused in the keyframes editor because the layer is locked. {name} is the layer name; 'Layers' is the layers panel.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.name-keyfra.note: Accessible name of the group of lanes for one layer in the keyframes editor. {name} is the layer or target name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.next-keyfra.note: Button on the timeline toolbar that moves the playhead to the next keyframe.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.no-keyframe.text: No keyframes yet: use Add property, or double-click its lane.
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.no-keyframe.note: Empty state on the timeline when the selected part has no keyframes. Add property is the name of a button.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.no-properti.text: No properties animate yet. Use Add property, or double-click a lane.
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.no-properti.note: Empty state on the timeline when the animation animates no property at all. Add property is the name of a button.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.nothing-pas.text: Nothing pasted: those properties do not fit here
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.nothing-pas.note: Message after Paste on the timeline when the copied keyframes hold properties that this target cannot animate.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.onion-skin.note: Label of the timeline toggle that marks the keyframes around the playhead. Animation term; keep it as the standard name.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.onion-skin-.text: Onion skin: mark the keyframes around the playhead
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.onion-skin-.note: Tooltip of the timeline toggle that highlights the keyframes before and after the playhead.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.paste-at-th.note: Tooltip of the Paste button when keyframes are copied. {target} is the name of the selected layer or target; keep the Ctrl+V shortcut.

vars.target: The value that replaces target in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.paste-keyfr.note: Tooltip and accessible name of the timeline button that pastes the copied keyframes at the playhead.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.pct-seconds.note: Spoken value of the playhead slider on the ruler. {pct} is the position as a percentage and {seconds} is the time in seconds with two decimals.

vars.pct: The value that replaces pct in the text.
vars.seconds: The value that replaces seconds in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.playhead.note: Accessible name of the draggable marker on the timeline ruler that shows the current moment of the loop.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.previous-ke.note: Button on the timeline toolbar that moves the playhead to the previous keyframe.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.property.note: Column heading on the timeline for the animated property (rotation, opacity and so on) of each lane.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.ruler-in-pe.text: Ruler in percent of the cycle or in seconds
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.ruler-in-pe.note: Accessible name of the timeline toggle that switches the ruler between percent and seconds.
Tooltip of the timeline ruler toggle while the ruler shows percent; clicking it switches to seconds.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.ruler-in-se.note: Tooltip of the timeline ruler toggle while the ruler shows seconds; clicking it switches to percent.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.seconds.note: Name of the seconds choice for the timeline ruler unit, as opposed to percent of the cycle.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.select-ever.note: Tooltip of a lane header that selects all its keyframes. {name} is the lowercase property name; Shift adds to the current selection.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.selected.note: Lowercase word appended to a keyframe marker's description to say it is part of the current selection.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.skipped-ski.text: ; {skipped} skipped (not for this target or lane)
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.skipped-ski.note: Appended to the paste announcement, so keep the leading semicolon. {skipped} is how many pasted keyframes did not fit the target layer or lane.

vars.skipped: The value that replaces skipped in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.snap-grid.note: Label of the timeline control that sets the grid step keyframes snap to while dragging.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.snap-to-key.text: Snap to keyframes, the playhead and the grid (hold Shift to drag freely)
anim-studio.keyframes-editor.snap-to-key.note: Tooltip of the timeline snapping toggle. Shift is a key name.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.snapping.note: Label of the timeline toggle that makes dragged keyframes snap to other keyframes, the playhead and the grid.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.target-keyf.note: Name of a keyframe marker on a lane that covers all properties of a layer. {target} is the layer name; the result is capitalised afterwards.

vars.target: The value that replaces target in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.target-lane.note: Name of a keyframe marker on one property lane of a layer. {target} is the layer name and {lane} is the lowercase property name; the result is capitalised afterwards.

vars.lane: The value that replaces lane in the text.
vars.target: The value that replaces target in the text.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.timeline-vi.note: Accessible name of the group of zoom and ruler-unit controls that change how the timeline is displayed.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.zoom-in.note: Accessible name of the timeline zoom-in button. The tooltip with the shortcut is a separate key.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.zoom-in-ctr.note: Tooltip of the timeline zoom-in button with its keyboard shortcut Ctrl and plus. Keep the shortcut.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.zoom-out.note: Accessible name of the timeline zoom-out button. The tooltip with the shortcut is a separate key.

anim-studio.keyframes-editor.zoom-out-ct.note: Tooltip of the timeline zoom-out button with its keyboard shortcut Ctrl and minus. Keep the shortcut.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.1-percent.note: Option in the keyframe editor snap menu: snap to steps of one percent of the clip.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.30-fps.note: Frame-rate choice of 30 frames per second in the keyframes helper lists; keep the number and the unit abbreviation.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.5-percent.note: Option in the keyframe editor snap menu: snap to steps of five percent of the clip.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.animation-co.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: the colour that the animation itself applies to the icon, not a field label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.background.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: the fill behind the icon. A lane or option name, not a field label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.blur.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: the blur filter that softens the icon. A lane name, not a field label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.bottom.note: Name of the bottom-centre cell in the 3 by 3 pivot (origin) grid; used as its tooltip and accessible label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.bottom-left.note: Name of the bottom-left cell in the 3 by 3 pivot (origin) grid; used as its tooltip and accessible label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.bottom-right.note: Name of the bottom-right cell in the 3 by 3 pivot (origin) grid; used as its tooltip and accessible label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.brighten.note: Name of a lane or effect in the keyframes helper lists: makes the icon lighter. A verb used as a label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.centre.note: Name of the middle cell in the 3 by 3 pivot (origin) grid; used as its tooltip and accessible label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.colour.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: the icon's fill colour. A lane name, not a field label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.corner-radiu.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: how round the corners of the background shape are.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.custom-curve.note: Option in the easing list of the keyframes helpers: a curve the user draws, as opposed to a named preset.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.default.note: Option in a keyframes helper list meaning the built-in value is used, with nothing set by the user.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.draw-on.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: the stroke draws itself onto the icon, like a pen. Two words, a verb phrase.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.drop-shadow.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: a soft shadow cast behind the icon.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.element.note: Option in a keyframes helper list: the target is a single element (part) of the icon, not the whole icon.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.filter.note: Group name in the keyframes helper lists for image-effect lanes such as blur and greyscale; a noun, not a verb.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.glow.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: a soft light halo around the icon.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.greyscale.note: Name of a filter lane in the keyframes helper lists: drains the colour from the icon. British spelling.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.hue-shift.note: Name of a filter lane in the keyframes helper lists: rotates all colours around the colour wheel.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.icon.note: Option in a keyframes helper list: the target is the whole icon. Not the field label in the icon picker.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.left.note: Name of the middle-left cell in the 3 by 3 pivot (origin) grid; used as its tooltip and accessible label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.lift.note: Name of a lane or effect in the keyframes helper lists: the icon rises slightly, as if picked up.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.move-x.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: moves the icon sideways (horizontal axis). Keep the X.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.move-y.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: moves the icon up or down (vertical axis). Keep the Y.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.name.note: Option in a keyframes helper list: a lane or property is chosen by its name. Not a text-field label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.none.note: Option in a keyframes helper list meaning nothing is chosen, so no effect or easing is applied.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.opacity.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: how see-through the icon is. A lane name, not a field label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.right.note: Name of the middle-right cell in the 3 by 3 pivot (origin) grid; used as its tooltip and accessible label.

anim-studio.keyframes-utils.rotate.note: Name of a lane in the keyframes helper lists: turns the icon around its pivot. A verb used as a label.

anim-studio.validation-text.the-svg-is-l.note: Validation error when stored SVG markup exceeds the size limit.

anim-studio.validation-text.the-svg-is-t.note: Validation message under an SVG field in the studio when the markup has too many shapes or points.

anim-studio.validation-text.this-card-pl.text: This card plays engine {engine}; update Magic Card to play this animation.
anim-studio.validation-text.this-card-pl.note: Error when an animation needs a newer player. Engine is a version number; Magic Card is the product name.

vars.engine: The value that replaces engine in the text.

anim-studio.validation-text.unsupported-.note: Validation message under the version field of an animation in the studio; only version 1 is supported.

anim-studio.validation-text.use-1-32-low.text: Use 1-32 lowercase letters, digits, - or _ (starting with a letter or digit).
anim-studio.validation-text.use-1-32-low.note: Validation message under an id field in the studio; gives the allowed length and characters for ids up to 32 characters.

anim-studio.validation-text.use-1-64-low.text: Use 1-64 lowercase letters, digits, - or _ (starting with a letter or digit).
anim-studio.validation-text.use-1-64-low.note: Validation message under an id field in the studio; gives the allowed length and characters for ids up to 64 characters.

anim-studio.validation-text.use-keywords.text: Use keywords, lengths or percentages, e.g. "50% 100%".
anim-studio.validation-text.use-keywords.note: Validation message under the pivot field in the studio; says to use keywords, lengths or percentages and gives an example.

anim-studio.window.close.note: Tooltip of the close button in the floating studio window's title bar.

anim-studio.window.maximise.note: Tooltip of the button that enlarges the floating studio window to fill the screen.

anim-studio.window.move-window.note: Accessible label of the title bar that the user drags to move the studio window.

anim-studio.window.resize-window.note: Accessible label of the corner handle that the user drags to resize the studio window.

anim-studio.window.restore-size.note: Tooltip of the button that returns a maximised studio window to its previous size.
